snippet.title: Salvation: Echoes Of War | Final Look Trailer
snippet.description:
Don't miss Final Look Trailer for Salvation: Echoes of War

A third-person stealth adventure game developed by Infinite Entropy. 
Players will find themselves trapped in a post-war nightmare, tasked with solving puzzles, getting the jump on enemies, and escaping the hell that is the past. 

Salvation: Echoes of War is launching on September 1 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).

Wishlist now: 

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3741170/Salvation_Echoes_of_War/?curator_clanid=26335619

PlayStation: 
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10011081/

XBOX:
